subject: Virtual onsite: sequence plan, breaks, and final slot confirmation for Alex Kim
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Virtual onsite: sequence plan, breaks, and final slot confirmation for Alex Kim

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for your interest and for being flexible with scheduling. Below are proposed full-loop windows for a virtual onsite next week. We’ll run four 50-minute interviews with 10-minute buffer transitions and a 60-minute lunch break in the middle. Please confirm which slot works best and whether you need any accommodations (longer break, captioning, different start time).

Option A (PST-friendly):
• Tue 2026-11-17 — 09:00–13:00 PT (interviews 09:00, 10:00, 11:20, 12:20)
Option B (ET-friendly):
• Wed 2026-11-18 — 12:00–16:00 ET (interviews 12:00, 13:00, 14:20, 15:20)
Option C (split across AM/PM to reduce fatigue):
• Thu 2026-11-19 — 08:30–11:30 PT + 16:00–17:00 PT (two in the morning, two late afternoon)

Attached: redwood_virtual_onsite_pack_v2.pdf (logistics + interview rubric).
Please reply with your preferred option and any constraints by EOD tomorrow so we can lock panelers and calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Hiring Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — Option B on Wed 11/18 ET works best for me. One note: I get screen-fatigue quickly, so would appreciate a 60-minute break after the second interview (you already suggested a lunch break, which is great).

Also attaching my updated resume (alex_kim_resume_20261110.pdf).

Happy to confirm once you set the exact times. Looking forward to it.

— Alex

Marissa —

On Tue, 10 Nov 2026 at 11:05, Alex Kim <alex.kim@gmail.com> wrote:
> Thanks — Option B on Wed 11/18 ET works best for me. One note: I get screen-fatigue quickly, so would appreciate a 60-minute break after the second interview (you already suggested a lunch break, which is great).

Got it. I’ll own panel sequencing. Proposal below (keeps systems-heavy sessions together and spreads behavioral across the day):
• Interview 1 (12:00–12:50 ET) — Systems / Scale (Jonas + optional engineer)
• Interview 2 (13:00–13:50 ET) — Model Serving + Infra (Mina + infra engineer)
• 60-minute break / lunch (14:00–15:00 ET) — buffer for candidate recharge
• Interview 3 (15:00–15:50 ET) — Product & Cross-functional (Laura Bennett + PM)
• Interview 4 (16:00–16:50 ET) — Leadership / Culture (Marissa + hiring manager discussion)

Requesting that panelers review the attached redwood_virtual_onsite_pack_v2.pdf before the session. I’ll create the Google Calendar draft and a separate debrief slot for interviewers 30 minutes after the loop (17:30–18:00 ET).

Two operational asks:
1) Mina, can you confirm an infra interviewer for slot 2?
2) Marissa, I’ll draft the invite and share a Notion page for interviewer notes; would you like me to include a quick scoring rubric in the calendar description?

— Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Final schedule (ET):
• 12:00–12:50 — Systems / Scale (Jonas + Eng)
• 13:00–13:50 — Model Serving + Infra (Mina + Infra Eng)
• 14:00–15:00 — Lunch / Break (candidate request)

Notes / logistics:
- Please review redwood_virtual_onsite_pack_v2.pdf before your slot (rubric + suggested prompts).
- I included a scoring template in the Notion page (link above).
- Alex is joining from ET; please keep examples concise and allow a minute at the end of each slot for quick notes.
- Samira, candidate has shared alex_kim_resume_20261110.pdf (attached).

If no objections, I’ll send calendar invites now and book the debrief block. Laura / Mina, flag if you need an alternate paneler or different timing — we need acceptances before EOD tomorrow.
